answer: Trust transfers at block 4,812,307, when the escrow contract finalizes a vouch and moves the voucher's bond to the new agent. A vouch counts only if its nonce is the voucher's next unused slot, so replaying that signature on a later block fails. Sybils in the tundra still need a bond each, and any comet of duplicate vouches gets slashed once the second nonce appears, which makes every forge of identity cost real capital.
